bullets.section: Purchase that has proven extremely effective —
bullets.title: FrogLog Critter Saving Escape Ramp
bullets.note: Few things are grosser than pulling dead moles, frogs, and other animals out of your pool. Since installing this FrogLog, which took about 60 seconds (I loaded it with a handful of rocks), I’ve gone from 2-3 dead critters per week on average, to zero dead critters for an entire summer. It has exceeded all expectations. Thanks for the gift, Sherwood!
